name: Surge Claws
description: Advanced combat gauntlets that channel raw electricity through your strikes. Inspired by electric-based heroes.

surge_strike.title: Surge Strike
surge_strike.description: Passive: melee hits discharge electricity and apply Shock to nearby struck targets.
commands: execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..4,nbt={HurtTime:10s},limit=1,sort=nearest] eop:shock 4 0 true
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..4,nbt={HurtTime:9s},limit=1,sort=nearest] eop:shock 4 0 true
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..4,nbt={HurtTime:8s},limit=1,sort=nearest] eop:shock 4 0 true
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..4,nbt={HurtTime:7s},limit=1,sort=nearest] eop:shock 4 0 true
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..4,nbt={HurtTime:6s},limit=1,sort=nearest] eop:shock 4 0 true
execute at @s run particle minecraft:electric_spark ~ ~1 ~ 0.25 0.2 0.25 0.02 8

electric_shield.title: Ion Field
electric_shield.description: Detonate a charged ion aura that shocks nearby targets and surges harder in rain.
commands: effect give @s minecraft:absorption 3 1 true
effect give @s minecraft:resistance 3 1 true
execute at @s run damage @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..6] 6 minecraft:magic by @s
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..6] eop:shock 6 0 true
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..6] minecraft:slowness 4 1 true
execute if predicate eop:rain_check at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,distance=..8] eop:shock_stronger 5 0 true
execute at @s run particle minecraft:electric_spark ~ ~1 ~ 2.4 1.0 2.4 0.08 120
execute at @s run particle minecraft:entity_effect ~ ~1 ~ 1.5 0.6 1.5 0.0 35
playsound minecraft:entity.lightning_bolt.impact player @s ~ ~ ~ 0.9 0.9

chain_lightning.title: Lightning Beam Hand
chain_lightning.description: Fire a continuous lightning beam from your hand.

chain_lightning_shock.title: Lightning Beam Shock
chain_lightning_shock.description: Applies Shock while Lightning Beam Hand is active.
commands: execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,sort=nearest,limit=1,distance=..12] eop:shock 2 0 true

web_shot.title: Web Shot
web_shot.description: Fire a charged web blast that snares and weakens your nearest target.

entity_data.CommandOnEntityHit: execute at @s run setblock ~ ~ ~ minecraft:cobweb replace
entity_data.CommandOnBlockHit: execute at @s run setblock ~ ~ ~ minecraft:cobweb replace

web_zip.title: Web Zip
web_zip.description: Launch forward in a fast web zip for mobility and repositioning.
commands: execute at @s run particle minecraft:item minecraft:cobweb ^ ^1 ^1 0 0 0 0 1 force
execute at @s run particle minecraft:item minecraft:cobweb ^ ^1 ^3 0 0 0 0 1 force
execute at @s run particle minecraft:item minecraft:cobweb ^ ^1 ^5 0 0 0 0 1 force
execute at @s run particle minecraft:item minecraft:cobweb ^ ^1 ^7 0 0 0 0 1 force
execute as @s at @s run tp @s ^ ^ ^10
effect give @s minecraft:slow_falling 3 0 true
execute at @s run particle minecraft:cloud ~ ~1 ~ 0.4 0.2 0.4 0.01 25
execute at @s run particle minecraft:item minecraft:cobweb ~ ~1 ~ 0.3 0.2 0.3 0.01 12
playsound minecraft:entity.fishing_bobber.retrieve player @s ~ ~ ~ 0.8 1.4

web_swing.title: Web Swing
web_swing.description: Hold to swing forward on a web line.

execute at @s run particle minecraft:item minecraft:cobweb ^ ^3 ^4 0 0 0 0 1 force
execute at @s run particle minecraft:item minecraft:cobweb ^ ^4 ^6 0 0 0 0 1 force
execute at @s run particle minecraft:item minecraft:cobweb ^ ^5 ^8 0 0 0 0 1 force
